scope: Paired alternating separate native binaries use identical generated original Unit.update source; only runtime property-index layout feature differs. Every ordered fixture event and selected state bit matches pinned jitless Node. JSON parse uses actual source table bytes; parsed heap property order, raw numeric/string values, prototypes and IDs hash identically between layouts. Counts/timings include an identical atomic counting allocator, whose overhead depends on allocation count and can amplify allocation-saving speedups. RSS monitor samples100ms. This is a component/layout experiment, not battle throughput or whole-program qualification.
